Akkodis ist ein globales Beratungsunternehmen für Digital Engineering, das Technologie und Talente zusammenbringt, um Transformation zu beschleunigen, Innovation voranzutreiben und eine intelligentere Zukunft zu gestalten. Mit mehr als 40.000 Expertinnen in über 30 Ländern verbinden wir Branchen und Technologien miteinander - von AI und Data Analytics bis zu Cloud, Edge, Automatisierung und Cybersecurity.
Stellenbeschreibung
* Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für die Leistungs- und Projektleitung von Studien zur Analyse von elektrischen Energiesystemen, Netzplanung und Netzentwicklung
 * Sie sind verantwortlich für die Planung und Analyse von elektrischen Energiesystemen, die Entwicklung von Netzstrukturen, die Simulation von elektrischen Energiesystemen und die Modellierung von Netzkomponenten einschließlich Leistungselektronik
 * Sie koordinieren und stimmen sich mit Ingenieuren aus verschiedenen technischen Gruppen und virtuellen Teams in einem multikulturellen Umfeld ab
 * Sie sind aktiv an Akquisitions- und Vertriebsaktivitäten beteiligt, um unser Geschäft zu erweitern
 * Sie integrieren leistungselektronische Geräte, erneuerbare Erzeugungsanlagen, Speichereinheiten usw. in Wechselstromnetze durch Konzeptstudien, Machbarkeitsstudien, Ausschreibungsstudien und Projektausführungen.
 * Des Weiteren sind Sie sind für die Koordination der externen Partner und Zulieferer
Profil
* Sie haben ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Leistungselektronik oder vergleichbar
 * Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Simulation von Energiesystemen (z.B. PSS/E, PowerFactory, PSCAD/EMTDC, RTDS, DigSilent, Matlab/Simulink usw.)
 * Sie haben Erfahrung im Umgang mit Mittel- und Hochspannung (HVDC/HGÜ) und/oder FACTS-Systemen
 * Der Umgang mit Transformatoren, Netzgeneratoren und Umrichtern stellt für Sie keine Herausforderung dar
 * Initiative, Kreativität, analytisches und strategisches Denken, Teamwork sowie die Begeisterung für Energietechnik zeichnen sie aus
 * Sie kommunizieren und dokumentiere sicher in Deutsch und Englisch

Xtended Engineering GmbH bringt qualifizierte Ingenieure mit
Unternehmen aus der Industrie und Wirtschaft zusammen. Unser Spektrum
umfasst dabei herausfordernde Projekte der Fahrzeugtechnik, Luft- und
Raumfahrt, Schienenfahrzeugtechnik, Sondermaschinenbau sowie IT &
Telekommunikation.
Mit XTENDED ENGINEERING sind Sie Teil eines Teams, das sich als
praxiserfahren, innovativ und durchsetzungsstark auszeichnet. In
unserem erfolgreichen und wachsenden Unternehmen bieten wir Ihnen
kreative und abwechslungsreiche Aufgabenstellungen, in denen Sie Ihre
eigenen Ideen verwirklichen und unsere attraktiven
Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten nutzen können. Unseren Mitarbeitern bieten
wir nicht nur eine leistungsgerechte Bezahlung, sondern ermöglichen
ihnen langfristige berufliche Perspektiven, angefangen von der
fachlichen und sozialen Kompetenz bis hin zur Führungskraft. Dies
geschieht durch ein angepasstes Schulungsprogramm und relevante
Projekte um die nächste Karrierestufe, beispielsweise vom
Projektmitarbeiter zum Projektleiter nachhaltig zu erreichen.
Zusätzlich bieten wir durch interne Schulungsprogramme, die durch
unsere Projektmitarbeiter realisiert werden, Fachvorträge an, die
sich z.B. an Qualitätsmanager (w/m/d), Projektleiter (w/m/d),
Konstrukteure (w/m/d), FEM Berechner (w/m/d), Versuchsingenieure
(w/m/d), Programmierer (w/m/d), Automatisierer (w/m/d) wenden.
We are currently recruiting in Muenchen
Responsibilities: 
- Contribution within the development of safety critical embedded real
time SW for aircraft systems
- according to RTCA/DO-178B, Level A to Level D
- Autonomous working according to AES and project specific processes
- Support the tailoring of development processes to project-specific
needs
- Support the Specification of Software High Level Requirements
- Development of Software Low Level Requirements
- Software Coding in C
- SW debugging
- Software integration and analysis
- Support the design of internal and external interfaces
- Design/adaptation of existing solutions for new applications by
using dedicated/standardized tools
- Support the definition of “Statement of Works” to be presented
to potential suppliers
- Configuration control / change management of all items produced
using applicable CM tools (e.g.
- Synergy, Dimensions) according to applicable Configuration
Management Plan.
Requirements: 
- Graduate Software Engineer (or equivalent knowledge and skills
acquired by other means)
- Experience in Software Development for at least 3 years
- Good English capabilities, both spoken and written, at least B2
(CEFR)
- High flexibility and adaptability
- Specification of high level and low level software requirements
(SRS, SDDD)
- Technical reviews
- Programming experience in C and/or Assembler Code
- V-model development cycle (preferably of safety critical software
acc. to RTCA/DO-178)
- Experience within the usage of hardware in the loop test facilities
- Python Test Script Language
- InCircuit-Debugger (Lauterbach)
- MISRA guidelines (C)
- DOORS
- Configuration management in SVN, or IBM Rational Synergy/Change, or
Serena Dimensions
- IBM - Rational Test RealTime
What we offer:
- Future prospects in an innovative, growing, and agile company
- An exciting work environment with diverse career opportunities

## Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) Aerospace Electronics Schwerpunkt Analog-/ Digital-/ Signalelektronik m/w/d
Das Unternehmen
Die Liebherr-Electronics and Drives GmbH ist Teil der internationalen Firmengruppe Liebherr. An zwei Standorten, Lindau und Biberach (Flugplatz), entwickelt und fertigt das Unternehmen hochqualitative Komponenten und Systeme für die Firmengruppe sowie für externe Kunden. Die Tätigkeitsfelder des Unternehmens umfassen die Bereiche elektrische Antriebstechnik, Elektronik und Steuerungstechnik. Zudem bietet die Liebherr-Electronics and Drives GmbH ihren Kunden ein umfangreiches Portfolio an Dienstleistungen – von der Entwicklung über die Produktion bis hin zur Qualifikation. Rund ein Viertel der circa 1000 Mitarbeitenden ist im Bereich Forschung und Entwicklung tätig. 
Hinweis zur Bewerbung:
Bitte beachten Sie, dass ausschließlich Bewerbungen über unser Online‑Portal berücksichtigt werden. Bewerbungen per E‑Mail oder Post können leider nicht entgegengenommen werden. 
### Faszinierendes schaffen: Ihre Aufgaben:
• Entwicklung von vielfältigen elektronischen und elektrischen Schaltungen für den Einsatz in Steuerungsrechnern der Luftfahrt
• Erarbeitung von Konzepten für elektronische Schaltungen entlang des gesamten Elektronik-Hardware-Entwicklungsablaufs nach Luftfahrtentwicklungsstandards mit den höchsten Sicherheitsanforderungen
• Eigenverantwortliche Erstellung der Umsetzungskonzepte, Schaltungsdesigns, Simulationen, Analysen ausgehend vom Requirements-Engineering bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme inklusive der notwendigen Dokumentation
• Eigenständige Durchführung und Dokumentation von Inbetriebnahmen sowie der Ergebnisbewertung
• analogen Schaltungen (Auswertung von unterschiedlichen Geräteschnittstellen und Signalen, z.B. Sensorik, Spannungsversorgung)
• digitalen Schaltungen, Prozessoren, Speichersysteme, FPGA / PLD, diverse Datenbussysteme
• funktionale Betrachtung aber auch im Bereich der Umweltanforderungen wie z.B. Störfestigkeiten
• Abstimmung und Koordination mit den Bereichen der Projektleitung, Mechatronik, Produktion, Qualitätsmanagement
### Stärken einbringen: Ihre Qualifikationen:
• Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
• Alternativ Ausbildung zum Techniker (m/w/d) Elektrotechnik mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung in der Elektronikentwicklung
• Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Hardware-Auslegung von Signalelektronik
• Kenntnisse im Bereich der analogen und digitalen Schaltungstechnik
• Kenntnisse in der Nutzung moderner EDV-Tools und Messmittel
• Kenntnisse des Luftfahrtentwicklungsprozesses (z.B. RTCA Do-254)
• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
• Teamfähigkeit
• Kommunikationsfähigkeit
• Bewusstsein für Kosten- und Termintreue
• Eigeninitiative
### Ihre Benefits: Das bieten wir Ihnen
Wir bieten Ihnen einen spannenden und sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem weltweit erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen. 
Zudem erwarten Sie diverse Sozialleistungen eines modernen Unternehmens sowie eine faire Vergütung:
• Kollegiales Miteinander und unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit mit KollegInnen und Geschäftspartnern
• Gestaltungsfreiraum für innovative Lösungen
• Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
• Faire, leistungsgerechte Vergütung inkl. tariflicher Sonderzahlungen
• Gute Work-Life-Balance – mit 30 Tagen Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit auf mobiles Arbeiten
• diverse Sozialleistungen wie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Betriebsrestaurant, Wegegeld
• Vorteile & Rabatte für Mitarbeitende, bspw. für Freizeit und Sport, Shopping, Tanken u.v.m.

Berufserfahrung

- Hohe Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

items.jobTitle: Software Engineer - Autonomous Air System V&V
items.jobDescription:
Who We Are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role
 Our Autonomous Air System V&V team builds the simulation and validation environments that enable rigorous testing of autonomous air systems before they ever leave the ground. We develop Software-in-the-Loop (SiL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) environments that allow engineers to integrate, test, and assure AI-driven capabilities against virtualised and representative hardware.
We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations – from mission planning to command and control (C2) and mission debrief – so must be both reliable and frictionless.
Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting backend engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you'll help us solve. To give some examples:
 Simulation frameworks (e.g., high-fidelity SiL/HiL environments, real-time and deterministic simulation) 
 Test automation (e.g., fault injection, automated test coverage, regression testing at scale) 
 Hardware-software integration (e.g., testing against representative hardware, sensor and actuator interfaces) 
 Real-time and high-performance computing (e.g., concurrency, low-latency execution, profiling and optimization) 
 Distributed systems (e.g., orchestrating complex multi-component test environments) 
 Deployment infrastructure (e.g., air-gapped devices and heterogeneous test rigs) 
 Machine learning (e.g., systems for testing and validating AI/ML model behaviour) 
 In several of these areas, we are working near the state-of-the-art; we actively read (and sometimes implement) research papers, and often need to push even further to make theory work in practice. In others, we are applying well-known techniques to real-world situations (with real-world limitations) that have never been used in before, which requires skill, diligence, and honing a deep understanding of the underlying technologies.
 The day-to-day
 Review code contributions, proposals, and RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others takes precedence over spending more time on your own work. 
 Design and develop modules in simulation and validation frameworks, writing high-performance Rust code for simulators and test infrastructure. 
 Build tools for automated test coverage, fault injection, and regression testing to ensure comprehensive validation of autonomous systems. 
 Work closely with autonomy and systems teams to capture requirements and ensure simulation environments accurately represent real-world conditions. 
 Debug and profile simulation performance, identifying bottlenecks and optimizing for speed, determinism, and fidelity. 
 Propose and implement new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or even full products across our stack. We encourage our engineers to look beyond their immediate team for missed opportunities, and to speak up when they identify one. 
 Become a mentor, find a mentee, and help support and develop our interviewing pipeline. The people make or break the company, and we want as many engineers as possible to be part of fostering and growing the organisation. 
 Share your experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, get together for smaller "let's learn together" groups, run topical office hours (e.g., on Rust), etc. to help each other get better with time. 
 Maintain our existing software stack, including working with internal and external customers to identify issues, improving operational reliability and performance, and fending off technical debt. The stack is primarily Rust and Python. 
 Maintain documentation and testing infrastructure, ensuring that our simulation environments are well-documented and accessible to other teams. 
 Further develop our tests and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and an extensive and ever-improving test suite is key to achieving that. And without thorough benchmarks, we would be flying blind. 
 Present your work at our weekly demo sessions. We want engineers to come together around what they are working on and to feel like they are not endlessly squirreling away at something that doesn't matter. To that end, we host (and actively work towards) demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing. 
 You should apply if you
 Write modern, maintainable Rust. 
 Have experience in simulation, testing, robotics frameworks or autonomous driving. 
 Are comfortable with complex systems and concurrency. 
 Care about reliability, performance, and safety. 
 Enjoy working on the interface between software and hardware. 
 Are motivated by fast feedback loops and real impact. 
 Can write legible, maintainable, and performant code. 
 Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing. 
 Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming. 
 Are comfortable working asynchronously (writing PRs and RFCs, having discussions by email). 
 Strive to improve yourself, your peers, and the culture you work in over time. 
 Feel like ethical considerations are an inherent part of engineering. 
 Note: We operate at an intersection where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
 Nice to have
 Aerospace or automotive background. 
 Software/Hardware-in-the-loop or simulation experience. 
 Experience building test rigs or ground-based integration systems. 
 Knowledge of flight dynamics or control systems. 
 Exposure to AI/ML systems testing. 
 Container-based and cloud-native application architectures (e.g., Docker, Azure, AWS). 
 Metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). 
 Production ML systems. 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns. 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world. 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward. 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts. 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about. 
 What We Offer
 A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking 
 Competitive compensation and VSOP options 
 Relocation support 
 Social and education allowances 
 Regular company events and all-hands to bring together employees as one team across Europe
 Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
Our Talent Science team has a mission to ensure that we follow objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient processes to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. We work closely with our key stakeholders to ensure that decisions are being made in the right way and that our hiring model supports the selection of world class talent. We lead an effective hiring ecosystem to deliver talent acquisition excellence. We leverage data to enable evidence-based decisions, weaving behavioural science through our selection process, working closely with our Hiring Leadership team who drive hiring at Canonical.
We are looking for exceptional people to join our team at the entry level. You will possess a psychology based degree with an exceptional academic track record from high school. You will also bring some relevant experience from the field of talent, from either university coursework relating to talent selection or from an internship or first job in a talent team. In this role you will learn how to implement hiring strategies that result in high performance outcomes of our people and contribute to leading our talent agenda.
The suitable candidate will bring an analytical mindset with a high level of curiosity to integrate data to draw insights and outcomes using SQL or Python. You will have the ability to prioritise and deliver work in a fast paced environment with a good level of self motivation and drive to operate in our remote based environment. With a keen interest in the assessment of talent you will demonstrate a passion for understanding human decisions and behaviours. Great communication skills are also key to this role as you will be working closely with senior stakeholders to ensure they stay on track with their hiring targets. Finally, we would like you to bring a passion and interest for technology platforms and automations to help us drive efficiencies in our processes.
 Location: These are remote based positions that are available in the EMEA region.
The role entails
 Learning how to assess candidates using behavioural interview techniques.
 Gaining a deep appreciation of the use of psychometrics in the workplace.
 Working on process and documentation efficiencies that fuel our hiring practices.
 Contributing to projects that drive successful hiring outcomes, many of which require advanced analytics skills to integrate data to draw insights.
 Building excellent stakeholder relationships to help design and implement solutions to complex problems that ultimately ensure we hire exceptional talent.
 Gaining a deep understanding of our systems and platforms to problem solve and support on hiring questions.
 Being at the forefront of ticket support and company channel questions, helping to solve issues as you gain a deep understanding of our processes.
 What we are looking for in you
 Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a psychology or people based subject. 
 Advanced analytical ability to dissect and analyse data using SQL, with Python and/or advanced statistical analysis advantageous.
 Exposure to the topic of talent through university degree coursework, a relevant internship or first job.
 A passion for working in the technology space with evidence as to why.
 Results driven with the ability to work at pace, with strong project management skills to roadmap, plan and deliver objectives working with the team.
 Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
 Drive, ambitious and curiosity to own breakthroughs in the talent field.
 Ability to travel internationally 2-4 times a year, for company events, occasionally for two weeks.
 Nice-to-have skills
 Advanced theory of psychometrics
 A deep understanding of the topic of intrinsic motivation
 What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
 Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
 Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
 Annual compensation review
 Recognition rewards
 Annual holiday leave
 Maternity and paternity leave
 Employee Assistance Programme
 Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
 Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
 About Canonical
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

AIT & Test Infrastructure Engineer - Solar Arrays 
 Location: Germering, on-site
 About the hiring company: 
 Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. What makes Dcubed special is that each of us is a space explorer at heart. 
 At Dcubed, we enable the future of space missions with high-performance, flight-proven release mechanisms and deployable structures. From cutting-edge Release Actuators to scalable Deployable Solar Arrays and innovative Deployable Antennas, our technologies are designed for user friendliness, availability, and reliability — whether for smallsats in LEO or large missions to Moon, Mars and beyond.
 About the role 
 As our AIT & Test Infrastructure Engineer - Solar Arrays (f/m/d) you will own the practical execution of hardware verification and validation activities from breadboard to flight demonstrator by developing test setups, integrating hardware, designing GSE, executing campaigns, and driving rapid learning cycles through hands-on experimentation.
 Responsibilities 
 Assembly, Integration and hardware testing
 Actively involved with the team in the definition of the Satellite and/or payload integration approach.
 Responsible for the implementation of Satellite and/or Payload integration procedures.
 Support in verification & validation activities
 GSE design, development and execution
 Execute project lifecycle hardware from concept to breadboards to engineering model
 Test infrastructure and laboratory support
 Define and execute development and qualification test campaigns, including vibration, shock, deployment and thermal.
 Support rapid prototyping, hands-on experimentation, and continuous improvement of products and engineering methodologies.
 Candidate requirements 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
 3+ years of experience in mechanical design, structural analysis, or space hardware development.
 Proven experience developing complex mechanical systems from concept through testing, qualification, and production.
 Strong expertise in CAD tools (SolidWorks preferred)
 Experience designing and executing qualification and verification campaigns for aerospace or high-performance hardware.
 Hands-on experience with manufacturing and prototyping of metal and plastic components using additive manufacturing, CNC machining, milling, turning, laser cutting, and other fabrication techniques.
 Experience building and testing prototypes, breadboards, engineering models, and development hardware.
 Strong problem-solving skills and ability to tackle complex and ambiguous engineering challenges.
 Hands-on mentality with a passion for building, testing, and improving hardware.
 Ability to balance technical excellence with pragmatism and execution speed.
 Comfortable operating under pressure while managing multiple technical activities and competing priorities.
 Fluent in English language
 Eligible to work in Germany
 Feel free to apply here or directly via https://dcubed.teamtailor.com/jobs/8219775-ait-test-infrastructure-engineer-solar-arrays-f-m-d

 Job Title
Power Electronics Engineer (all genders)
 Job Description
 In dieser Position hast du die Möglichkeit, Hochleistungs-Generatoren und Generator-Röhren-Einheiten für medizinische Röntgenanwendungen, wie z. B. CT-Systeme, zu entwickeln. Dabei arbeitest du an innovativen Technologien wie Leistungselektronik bis 120 kW, Analog- und Control-Elektronik, hardwarenaher Software, Hochstromleiterplatten sowie High-Speed-Digital-Design – von der ersten Auslegung bis zur Serienreife.
 Dein Job
 Eigenständige Spezifikation und Entwicklung komplexer Leiterplatten und Baugruppen mit Schwerpunkt auf Leistungselektronik sowie Analog- und Digitaltechnik. 
 Betreuung und Pflege von Baugruppen und Leiterplatten im Rahmen des Lifecycle Managements inklusive Fehlersuche, Qualifikation alternativer Bauteile, normgerechter Dokumentation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen.

 Abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Leistungselektronik, Analogtechnik und allgemeiner Elektrotechnik. 
 Erfahrung in Regelungstechnik sowie in der Simulation komplexer leistungselektronischer Systeme mit MATLAB/Simulink oder vergleichbaren Tools. 
 Kenntnisse im Umgang mit EDA-Tools (z. B. Cadence oder Mentor) sowie idealerweise Erfahrung in Hochspannungstechnik und hardwarenaher Software (DSP, FPGA). 
 Interesse an der Nutzung moderner, datenbasierter und KI-gestützter Tools zur Unterstützung von Entwicklungs- und Testaktivitäten. 
 Freude an der Arbeit in einem agilen, internationalen Team sowie eine selbstständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift.

 Über Philips
 Als Unternehmen für Gesundheitstechnologie steht für Philips das Wohl aller an erster Stelle. Jeder Mensch, wo auch immer auf unserem Planeten, verdient eine erstklassige Gesundheitsversorgung. LPA Design Engineer (m/f/d) 
 Hamburg, Germany | Full-time | Permanent 
 The Opportunity 
 Our client is a specialist deep-tech business developing advanced laser-plasma accelerator technology for next-generation muon production and imaging.
 They are looking for an LPA Design Engineer to lead the simulation, optimisation and physics-led design of a high-energy, high-charge laser-plasma accelerator.
 This role combines accelerator physics, PIC simulation, numerical optimisation and machine learning, with a direct connection between computational research and experimental hardware.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and optimise plasma density profiles to maximise high-energy muon production.
 Develop and extend particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation workflows from reduced-dimensionality models to full 3D.
 Build efficient optimisation loops, including multi-objective optimisation of muon yield and radiation dose.
 Develop physics-informed surrogate models and digital twins of the accelerator.
 Conduct tolerance, sensitivity and jitter studies to establish robust operating points.
 Work with experimental teams to translate simulation results into practical accelerator designs.
 What They're Looking For 
 Strong background in laser-plasma accelerator physics, including injection, dephasing, depletion and guiding.
 Practical PIC simulation experience using FBPIC, WarpX or comparable codes.
 Experience with Bayesian optimisation or other multi-objective optimisation methods.
 Machine learning experience, particularly physics-informed surrogate modelling.
 Strong Python programming and scientific computing skills.
 Experience with HPC environments and large-scale simulation workflows.
 What's On Offer? 
 Direct ownership of the accelerator's physics and working point.
 Opportunity to see simulation work translated into real experimental hardware.
 Access to high-performance computing and specialist GPU infrastructure.
 Equity participation and competitive compensation.
 Relocation and visa support where required.
 Interested? 
 If you specialise in laser-plasma physics, PIC simulations, computational optimisation or physics-informed machine learning, we'd welcome a confidential conversation.
 Please apply to find out more.

Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
 What You'll Do
 Own propulsion engineering for hypersonic vehicles, from early concept trades through to integrated, test-proven flight hardware.
 Develop and maintain propulsion performance models and use them in vehicle-level trade studies, mission analysis, and design decisions.
 Define propulsion system requirements, interfaces, and margins with the Systems, Aerodynamics, Aerothermal, Structures, and GNC teams.
 Lead how the propulsion system is integrated into the vehicle, including mechanical, thermal, and electrical interfaces and how they affect vehicle performance.
 Plan, run, and analyse propulsion test campaigns, from component-level tests through to integrated system tests. Work hands-on with test facilities and suppliers.
 Correlate test data with models, and feed the results back into design and performance predictions.
 Support CFD and analysis of internal flows and combustion-related phenomena where needed, working with the simulation teams.
 Manage propulsion suppliers and subcontractors technically, including specifications, design reviews, and acceptance testing.
 Put safe test operations and hazard analysis in place for propulsion activities, working with the HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) and Quality teams.
 Document designs, analyses, test procedures, and results to ensure traceability and configuration control.
 Who You Are
 A hands-on Propulsion Engineer with experience taking propulsion hardware or systems through analysis, test, and integration.
 Degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering (or related discipline); a postgraduate qualification in propulsion, combustion, or thermofluids is a plus.
 Strong grounding in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and propulsion system performance.
 Experience planning and running propulsion or combustion tests, including instrumentation and data analysis.
 Programming skills (e.g. Python or MATLAB) for performance modelling, data processing, and automation. Experience with CFD tools (e.g. Ansys Fluent, STAR-CCM+, or similar) is an advantage.
 Experience working with suppliers and test facilities in aerospace or defence programmes is a strong advantage.
 Comfortable making sound engineering judgements with incomplete data in fast‑moving, prototype‑heavy environments.
 What We Offer
 A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
 Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
 High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
 A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
 A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
 Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.
 At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative R&D Engineer to join our dynamic team at Hitachi, Ltd. This role involves contributing to the research, design, and development of cutting-edge technologies and products, pushing the boundaries of innovation within our diverse industrial sectors.
Job Responsibilities**
 Perform verification and validation of Substation Automation and Protection products, systems, and engineering tools.
 Design, execute, and document functional, integration, interoperability, regression, performance, and system-level test cases.
 Validate IEC 61850 services and system engineering, including MMS, GOOSE, Sampled Values, SCL files, and time synchronization where applicable.
 Test communication interfaces and protocols such as IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, DNP3, OPC UA, SNMP, and other relevant industrial protocols.
 Analyze network communication and troubleshoot system-level issues using tools such as Wireshark and protocol/test tools.
 Validate integration between IEDs, protection and control devices, SCADA systems, gateways, engineering tools, and communication networks.
 Integrate the industry standard redundancy protocols and time synchronization between devices. 
 Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects, working closely with development teams through resolution and verification.
 Contribute to test automation using Python or similar scripting technologies to improve test coverage and efficiency.
 Participate in cybersecurity and secure communication validation, including authentication, secure protocols, certificates, role-based access, and network security features where applicable.
 Prepare clear test specifications, test reports, defect reports, and technical documentation.
 Collaborate with local and global R&D teams to continuously improve test methods, automation, product quality, and validation efficiency.
 Job Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Power Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
 Good understanding of Substation Automation, Protection & Control, or power automation systems.
 Knowledge of IEC 61850 concepts and communication architecture.
 Familiarity with at least some industrial protocols such as IEC 60870-5-101/104, DNP3, OPC UA, Modbus, or SNMP.
 Basic understanding of Ethernet networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, redundancy, and time synchronization concepts.
 Experience with system testing, product validation, integration testing, or troubleshooting.
 Ability to analyze communication/network traces using Wireshark or similar tools.
 Basic programming or scripting knowledge, preferably Python.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

About us: 
 Aeva’s mission is to bring the next wave of perception to a broad range of applications from automated driving to industrial robotics, consumer electronics, consumer health, security, and beyond. Aeva is transforming autonomy with its groundbreaking sensing and perception technology that integrates all key LiDAR components onto a silicon photonics chip in a compact module. Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors uniquely detect instant velocity in addition to 3D position, allowing autonomous devices like vehicles and robots to make more intelligent and safe decisions.
 Role Overview:

 What you'll do 
 Architect, design, and develop a robust and scalable Python based test automation framework for performing fully automated tests for embedded devices and providing traceable matrix for requirements to test-case to defect tracking. Develop automation features that allow end-to-end test coverage for all software and system components
 Mentor a team of skilled engineers dedicated to developing test cases, following standard coding practices. Drive code reviews to ensure consistent coding standards across all team members
 Develop, implement, and optimize test strategies and plans for automotive software, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing

 What you'll have 
 BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
 8 - 12 years of experience in software testing of embedded devices, preferably in the automotive industry
 Expert proficiency in Python and C++ programming and relevant libraries/frameworks for test automation
 Prior experience architecting test frameworks
 Proficiency in test-case development with docker/Kubernetes
 Practical knowledge of verification and validation means using testbeds and simulators as well as experience with hardware in the loop (HIL) and software in the loop (SIL) test environments
 Knowledge of Embedded device testing, REST APIs, UI testing, Selenium/Playwright, Embedded Linux, Docker, SSH, Shell scripting, Linux services, Computer networks
 Experience with continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices using Jenkins, Jira, Bitbucket, Agile methodologies, following sprint cycle for test-case development, system and integration testing
 Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and break down into simple sprint stories
 You have a problem-solving mindset and, able to mentor and guide juniors in solving daily development challenges
 Proven ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and projects simultaneously
 What's in it for you 
 Knowledge of automotive testing standards and frameworks, such as ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, ASPICE, etc
 Understanding of automotive software systems, including embedded systems, ADAS, infotainment, or electric vehicle control software
 Experience with JAMA for requirements management software (or equivalent)
 Experience with JIRA for defect tracking and familiar with Agile methodologies

 Understanding the TCMS architecture of Rolling Stock platforms such as Metro and Locomotives and gaining domain knowledge of rolling stock business operations.

 About The Team
 You will join a focused team of domain experts building a greenfield, in-house L2+ ADAS software stack for Indian road conditions, covering four-wheelers and two-wheelers. The team designs and owns the complete architecture, algorithms, and tooling, from first principles through to deployment on automotive-grade ECUs. Role purpose
The ACC Architect leads the concept, architecture, and algorithm development of Adaptive Cruise Control, from target selection and driving policy through to the longitudinal motion request. The role works closely with the Motion Planning & Controls team, which owns the longitudinal controller, and spans the full lifecycle from requirements through simulation, embedded implementation, and in-vehicle tuning.

 Define the functional architecture of ACC, including target selection, driving policy, and the function state machine (standby, active, override, fault, and driver handover).

 Design the driving policy: time-gap and standstill-distance control, set-speed management, curve-speed adaptation, and comfort and jerk limits. 
 Define the kinematic acceleration interface to the longitudinal controller jointly with the Motion Planning & Controls team, including limits, rates, and degradation behaviour . 
 Derive stakeholder, system, and software requirements with measurable acceptance criteria and full traceability to verification. 
 Validate the function in closed-loop simulation and through resimulation of recorded vehicle data; perform root-cause analysis of comfort and safety issues. 
 Implement production-grade algorithms in C++ and support integration on target ECUs within defined memory and runtime budgets. 
 Scale the function across four-wheeler and two-wheeler variants from a common architecture. 
 Define and track function KPIs: time-gap accuracy, false-target rate, comfort metrics, and availability. 
 Contribute to safety analysis in line with ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF).

 Configurer et utiliser des plateformes de tests et bancs ferroviaires incluant des simulateurs d’ATS (Automatic Train Supervision) et de CBTC (Communication-Based Train Control).

 Mettre en place des campagnes de tests automatiques via des scripts (Python, Shell).
 Analyser les anomalies, investiguer les écarts et rédiger les rapports de test et de conformité pour certification (SIL 2 à 4).
 Collaborer avec les équipes projet et ingénierie système sur l’ensemble du cycle en V.

 Connaissance des systèmes et protocoles ferroviaires, idéalement ATS, CBTC, ERTMS.
 Bonnes bases en tests système et validation fonctionnelle dans un environnement SIL (Safety Integrity Level).
 Familiarité avec les outils ALM (DOORS, Polarion) pour gestion d’exigences.
 Scripting Python pour automatisation de tests, CI/CD (Jenkins) apprécié.
 Sensibilité forte aux normes ferroviaires (EN 50128, EN 50129) et à la traçabilité réglementaire.
 Soft skills : rigueur, analyse, esprit collaboratif, bonne communication technique.
 Rejoindre SII Engineering & Cyber en Île-de-France, c’est intégrer un partenaire historique des grands acteurs de la Défense, de l’Aéronautique, du Ferroviaire et de l’Industrie critique.

Rejoindre SII, c’est s’engager dans une aventure collective : Let’s Tech Together !
 Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif.

items.jobTitle: Forward Deployed Engineer – AI Agents & Enterprise Software
items.jobDescription:
You love building something people can actually use: the moment an integration works, an agent takes a tedious task off someone’s hands, or an idea becomes a useful tool. At XALT, you work closely with the people you build for, taking their solution from the first conversation into production.
 Your customers will be enterprises and public-sector organisations. Your focus will be AI agents with XALT Northstar or development platforms in the Atlassian ecosystem. We will work out together which area fits your experience and interests; working across both is possible. What you learn in customer projects will feed back into our own products.
 What we are working towards 
 We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on.
 What you will do
 Turn business problems into practical technical solutions together with the customer.
 Write production code and integrate agents into existing systems and workflows.
 With a Northstar focus, build and operate personal and operational agents using MCP servers, Agent Skills, evals, guardrails and observability.
 With an Atlassian focus, develop platforms and workflows using Forge, Rovo and CI/CD so development teams can use agents reliably.
 Take solutions into production, evaluate their quality and improve them based on actual use.
 Bring insights from customer projects into our products.
 What you bring
 Experience writing and reviewing production code, for example in TypeScript or Python, across both backend and frontend
 Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers and CI/CD, for example AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform or GitLab
 Practical experience with LLMs and agentic systems, including evals that detect errors and regressions
 At least one agent or AI workflow you have built yourself and put into production , which you can demonstrate live during the application process (see “Your AI example”)
 Enjoyment of working directly with customers and the ability to make reasoned technical decisions with incomplete information
 Business-fluent German and English
 What we offer
 Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools
 €70,000–100,000 gross per year , depending on experience; we are open to going beyond this range for exceptional senior candidates with a proven record of running agents in production
 The opportunity to follow your solutions from the first conversation into customers’ daily work and see the difference they make
 Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution
 ### Your working arrangements
 We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role.
 Full-time
 Work within an international company with teams in Munich, Leipzig, Manila and New York
 ### Our professional community
 Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. For a closer look at our work, see Philipp’s talk from Charlotte.
 Your AI example
 We would like to understand how you approach problems and what you have learned along the way. Bring a process you have automated yourself with AI and show it to us live. Walk us through your contribution, whether the workflow works consistently, and what has measurably improved. We are also interested in its limitations and how you check the results. One example is enough; you can recreate it with test data. Please do not share confidential information or protected code.
 Your application
 Does this sound like work you would enjoy? We would love to hear from you. Send your CV to ----- and tell us what you would like to work on. The conversation should also give you room to ask about the team, your responsibilities and what you need to do good work. We will discuss the interview arrangements and your AI demonstration with you personally. You can also send any questions beforehand to ----- Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Gestalte die digitale Zukunft von Finance & HR aktiv mit!

 Integration & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst die Anbindung der Systeme an weitere Anwendungen weiter und identifizierst Potenziale für Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI, insbesondere in Finanz- und HR-Prozessen.
 Application Management: Du analysierst und behebst Störungen, begleitest Changes und Releases und unterstützt den Betrieb weiterer Business Applications.

 Persönlichkeit: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und IT-Kolleg etwas zu bewegen.
 Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Dein Profil ab.
 Deine Vorteile

 Flexibles Arbeiten: Deine Arbeitszeit kannst Du flexibel gestalten. Mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ist nach Absprache möglich. Für die Position ist eine Präsenz im Büro an etwa zwei bis drei Tagen pro Woche vorgesehen.
 Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland: Zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit, bis zu 30 Tage jährlich aus EU, EWR oder der Schweiz zu arbeiten.
 Weiterentwicklung: Individuelle Weiterbildungsangebote, Workshops, Fachveranstaltungen und Konferenzen unterstützen Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.
 Gesundheit & Mobilität: Du profitierst unter anderem von Gesundheits- und Sportangeboten sowie einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket.
 Team & Kultur: Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und einem starken Fokus auf gemeinsames Lernen.
 Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit einer Beschäftigung in Teilzeit unterstützen die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.

quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. 
 quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.
 Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.
 The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. 
 Where this is going 
 Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.
 That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.
 One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.
 Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. 
 Why this role exists 
 Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.
 What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.
 That is the opening. 
 How we work 
 We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.
 We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.
 And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.
 Tasks
 What you will own 
 Everything on the screen:
 The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.
 The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.
 The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.
 Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.
 The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.
 Where design ends, engineering begins. 
 We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.
 Requirements
 Who we are looking for 
 You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.
 You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.
 You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.
 You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does.
 Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works.
 The Team 
 We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action.
 This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.

items.jobDescription:
We Are 
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with customers across industries to maximize R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 
 You Are 
 You are an experienced applications or signoff engineer who combines strong hands-on expertise in physical verification and parasitic extraction with the judgment to lead complex customer engagements. You work independently on new and ambiguous assignments, determine an effective technical approach, and collaborate across customer teams, Sales, Business Units, and R&D to deliver critical results. 
 You can diagnose difficult ICV and StarRC issues on advanced process nodes, including DRC/LVS/FILL/PERC discrepancies, RC modeling anomalies, extraction accuracy concerns, full-chip scalability limits, and timing correlation problems. You communicate clearly in sensitive or high-pressure situations, influence stakeholders toward practical solutions, and help raise the capability of less-experienced engineers through coaching and technical review. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Own complex customer engagements using ICV and StarRC, from initial diagnosis through technical closure, to improve signoff readiness and support successful tape-outs.
 Debug advanced physical verification and parasitic extraction issues, including DRC/LVS discrepancies, RC modeling anomalies, device and layer-mapping problems, timing correlation gaps, and full-chip performance or scalability limitations.
 Determine methods and procedures for new assignments, define validation criteria, and drive evidence-based root-cause analysis across customer environments, field teams, and R&D.
 Develop and refine ICV and StarRC methodologies that improve accuracy, runtime, memory efficiency, automation, and reliability for block, full-chip, custom, digital, and multi-die flows.
 Support integrated flows and the full range of advanced ICV and StarRC verification and extraction capabilities, including emerging 3DIC designs.
 Apply advanced debugging, analysis, and extraction features of ICV and StarRC to accelerate root-cause analysis and signoff closure.
 Lead technical discussions during critical tape-out phases, align priorities across customer engineering teams and internal stakeholders, and drive blocking issues toward timely resolution.
 Work directly with Synopsys R&D and Product teams to reproduce issues, communicate requirements, validate fixes and enhancements, and influence roadmap priorities based on measurable customer impact.
 Provide technical guidance, review, and coaching to other applications engineers; create reusable debugging frameworks, training material, and documented best practices for the broader field organization.
 Leverage scripting and AI-assisted techniques to automate analysis, accelerate issue triage, improve methodology development, and increase engineering productivity across ICV and StarRC workflows.
 The Impact You Will Have 
 Enable customers to achieve faster and more reliable signoff closure on advanced semiconductor designs.
 Reduce technical risk, tape-out delay, and potential silicon re-spin exposure by resolving complex verification, extraction, and timing-correlation issues.
 Improve adoption and effectiveness of ICV and StarRC through customer-specific methodology development and scalable full-chip solutions.
 Create measurable impact across multiple related customer or product areas by connecting field requirements with Business Unit and R&D execution.
 Strengthen customer trust and Synopsys technical credibility through consistent ownership, clear communication, and successful execution in critical situations.
 Build organizational capability by reviewing technical work, coaching engineers, and converting individual solutions into reusable knowledge and practices.
 What You'll Need 
 Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in applications engineering, semiconductor design, physical verification, parasitic extraction, or signoff. Candidates with equivalent advanced expertise and impact will also be considered.
 Advanced hands-on knowledge in physical verification and/or parasitic extraction using commercial EDA tools. Direct experience with ICV and StarRC is strongly preferred; equivalent experience with other vendors' DRC, LVS, FILL, PERC, or xRC (parasitic extraction) tools is also relevant.
 Strong understanding of semiconductor design and foundry flows, including DRC, LVS, FILL, PERC or reliability verification, RC extraction, device and layer mapping, timing correlation, and block-to-full-chip signoff.
 Familiarity with Advanced nodes, multi-patterning, and 3DIC or silicon photonics verification and extraction is a plus.
 Demonstrated ability to independently resolve complex and ambiguous technical issues using structured analysis, measurable validation criteria, and sound engineering judgment.
 Experience collaborating with semiconductor customers, Sales, Business Units, Product teams, and R&D during evaluations, methodology development, production deployment, or tape-out support.
 Working proficiency in Linux/Unix and scripting with Tcl, Python, shell, or equivalent languages for automation and workflow customization.
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
 Strong Korean and English communication skills are preferred for customer engagement and collaboration with global Business Unit and R&D teams.
 Who You Are 
 You take independent ownership of complex assignments while knowing when to engage specialists or escalate business-critical risks.
 You evaluate incomplete or conflicting data, identify the most relevant technical factors, and establish a practical path to a defensible conclusion.
 You communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and can influence adjacent teams in ambiguous or sensitive situations.
 You balance urgent customer needs with product quality, validation discipline, and long-term methodology improvements.
 You review work constructively, coach less-experienced engineers, and help teams adopt consistent technical and customer-engagement practices.
 You connect technical execution to broader customer adoption, product improvement, and business outcomes, backing your conclusions with clear evidence.
 The Team You'll Be Part Of 
 You will join the Global Signoff Organization supporting customers using ICV and StarRC across physical verification and parasitic extraction workflows. You will work closely with Korea customer engineering teams and collaborate with global Business Unit, Product, and R&D organizations. The role combines direct customer ownership, advanced technical problem solving, methodology development, and contribution to the broader capability of the applications engineering organization.

items.jobDescription:
About MORAI 
 MORAI (www.morai.ai) is a South Korean technology company specialized in high-fidelity simulation
 and digital twin platforms for autonomous systems. MORAI provides simulation environments for
 autonomous vehicles, robotics, defense systems, UGVs/UAS, and future mobility applications,
 enabling virtual development, testing, validation, and verification of safety-critical systems.
 The company combines expertise in digital twin simulation, autonomous systems validation, sensor
 and environment modeling, scenario-based testing, AI-driven verification workflows, and virtual
 homologation and credibility assessment. MORAI’s mission is to accelerate the safe deployment of
 autonomous technologies through credible simulation and virtual validation.
 About the Position 
 The position is for a Forward Deployed Engineer who can build custom integrations to fit customer’s
 requirements. General SWE skills are core to the position as the candidate acts as a bridge between
 MORAI Simulation platform, modelling and simulation I/O data, automation logic, and third-party
 tools. While he/she does not need to be an expert in sensor or vehicle modeling, he/she must be
 experienced with customer deployments and highly proficient in data preparation especially for
 Unreal, scripting (via APIs), and system integration (especially ROS2).
 Key Responsibilities 
 The candidate must be able to perform these tasks independently.
 ● Customer integrations: Build integrations and custom software implementations tailored to
 specific customer requirements. These integrations are primarily with 3rd party autonomy or
 assisted driving stacks (system under test) in multiple industries (primarily defense,
 automotive, mining) and domains (land onroad/offroad, air); integrations happen oftentimes
 via ROS2, but may also be custom (e.g. shared memory, C/C++ API or Python API).
 ● Integrations with 3rd party tools: Build integrations with partner systems e.g. for
 co-simulations with 3rd party sensor or dynamics models; This may include FMU
 integrations; also communication systems to central control units (e.g. command center,
 operations center or mission manager system) will need to be designed and set up.
 ● Technical scoping with customers: Communicate with software engineers (perception,
 autonomy, control engineers) on the customer side to understand key requirements, develop
 and align solutions.
 ● Internal project planning: Collaborate with engineering teams in Korea to clarify product
 requirements and solution concepts for customer deliverables and take ownership for
 successful implementation of solutions.
 ● Engineering Leadership Pathway: Help build and scale the local engineering repository in
 Munich, as the department grows, and spearheading regional technical alignment.
 Preferred Experience 
 The candidate ideally has a conceptual understanding of these topics to communicate effectively with
 domain specialists, but does not need to be the primary expert.
 A. Domain and Industry Knowledge
 ● Scenarios, Standardization, and Testing: Understands how virtual testing is performed for
 ADAS and automotive systems and how simulation tools are used to support such
 processes. Aware of current standards around composing scenarios and executing test
 regimes. Knowledge of automotive regulations, certification processes and homologation is
 a plus.
 ● Virtual Sensor Modeling: Understands the physics/basics of Camera, Radar, and Lidar
 systems, and how they are modeled in simulations. Basic knowledge of automotive
 perception systems and underlying concepts.
 ● Digital Twin Creation: Experiences in creating high fidelity digital twins based on common
 game engine environments, Unreal Engine preferred.
 ● V2X / Connected Vehicle: Basic understanding of V2V and V2I communication concepts.
 B. Technical Knowledge and Skillset
 ● APIs and Automation: Experience applying APIs and writing scripts to use and/or enhance
 software tools. Adapt at learning new tooling and custom solutions.
 ● ROS / ROS2: Experience either using or building autonomy systems using ROS environments
 or adjacent systems.
 ● Co-Simulation: Understanding the basics of connecting different tools for offline/online
 co-simulation. Familiarity with industry tools such as Mathworks Simulink/Stateflow and
 Ansys AVxcelerate is a plus.
 Key Requirements 
 ● B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
 ● 3–5+ years of experience in hands-on engineering role, preferably in domains related to
 ADAS, autonomous driving, or robotics.
 ● Strong Python programming skills required (OOP, data structures, error handling); Scripting
 for MORAI Python API (Scene generation, parameterization); Data analysis libraries (Pandas,
 NumPy) for processing simulation results (API/Telemetry data); Git / GitHub / GitLab; Linux
 (Ubuntu preferred for ROS and server setups), Windows (for local editor work).
 ● (Preferred) C++ for customer integrations and integrations with the Unreal Engine
 ecosystem; Unreal Engine: Experience with Unreal Engine and 3D model creation;
 Containerization: Docker / Docker Compose (for setting up headless simulation
 environments in CI/CD pipelines); TypeScript, JavaScript, Web development.
 ● Fluent English and German (written and spoken).
 ● Willingness to travel across EMEA and to South Korea.
 What We Offer 
 ● Opportunity to shape the future of autonomous systems validation.
 ● Work on cutting-edge modelling and simulation technologies for automotive, defense,
 robotics.
 ● International collaboration with engineering teams in South Korea and leading industry
 players.
 ● High level of responsibility and technical ownership.
 ● Dynamic and entrepreneurial work environment.
 ● Flexible hybrid working model.
 ● Competitive Compensation package.
 Joining our Munich hub means working at the intersection of fast deployment and deep-tech
 innovation. You will contribute to major European simulation and defense initiatives, while gaining
 increasing design autonomy as our EMEA engineering team expands- including access to the
 localized core codebase and opportunities to shape the technology at its core.
 Beschäftigungsverhältnis: Vollzeit

 Du entwickelst und baust neue Hardware-in-the-Loop-(HiL)-Testumgebungen für die Integration und den Test von Software auf
 Testframeworks zur Automatisierung von Testprozeduren entwickelst du kontinuierlich weiter

Energy Storage System Solution & Architecture Expert (m/f/d) 
 Nuremberg, Germany · On-site · Permanent
 A global technology leader is seeking to partner with an Expert in Energy Storage Systems Solutions and Architecture. This is a senior, expert-track role for an engineer who wants to define what the next generation of BESS looks like. You’ll design advanced system architectures for utility-scale, commercial & industrial, PV + storage and high-power applications such as AI and HPC data centres. Your work will directly shape future products and technology roadmaps.
 What you’ll do 
 Analyse future application requirements across utility-scale, C&I, PV + BESS, data centre and hybrid behind-the-meter / front-of-the-meter systems
 Research and develop next-generation ESS/BESS architectures, covering topology, battery configuration, DC distribution, power conversion, protection, thermal management and system-level control
 Develop AC- and DC-coupled concepts and translate grid and application needs into DC-side specifications
 Lead grid integration and control concepts, including grid codes, voltage and frequency support, short-circuit behaviour and grid-forming operation
 Model and optimise systems for efficiency, availability, lifetime and total cost of ownership using MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS, PowerFactory or similar tools
 Support prototypes, CHIL/PHIL testing and engineering validation
 Track emerging technologies and European grid codes and standards, and collaborate with global R&D teams, universities and research institutes
 What you’ll bring 
 Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Power Systems, Energy Systems, Control Engineering or a related field
 Typically 10+ years of industrial or applied R&D experience in battery storage, grid-scale power conversion or power systems, at senior or principal level
 Deep expertise in BESS architecture, power electronics (PCS/inverters, DC/DC converters), grid integration, grid codes and grid-forming control
 A proven track record of defining system architectures and technical specifications, backed by strong modelling and simulation skills
 Experience leading multidisciplinary R&D projects in international teams, with fluent English
 Highly valued: hands-on prototyping, system integration, HIL testing, commissioning or product development
 Why apply? 
 A senior technical-authority role with real influence over product direction
 Work at the forefront of grid-forming storage, high-power DC architectures and data centre energy solutions
 Collaborate with global engineering teams and leading European research partners
 A permanent position in Nuremberg, a hub for power electronics and energy innovation
 If this role is of interest please apply directly on LinkedIn or send a copy of your CV to jg@eu-recruit.com.
 By applying to this role you understand that we may collect your personal data and store and process it on our systems. For more information please see our Privacy Notice (https://eu-recruit.com/about-us/privacy-notice/)
